messages.subject: question on R.oo/R.methodsS3
parts:
I apologize in advance if this is not the ideal place for a question
about building packages with R.oo/R.methodsS3....


When I generate a new S3 class, such as in the following:

setConstructorS3("Sample", function(chromosomeLengths=NULL, ...) {
if (is.null(chromosomeLengths)) {
if (length(.GlobalEnv$chromosomeLengths) != 0) {
chromosomeLengths <- .GlobalEnv$chromosomeLengths
} else {
throw("Chromosome lengths must be specified!")
}
} else {
chromosomeLengths <- chromosomeLengths
}
nChromosomes <- length(chromosomeLengths)
chromosomes <- list()
for (ii in 1:nChromosomes) {
chromosomes[[ii]] <- data.frame(startpos=numeric(), endpos=numeric
(),
cn=numeric())
}
pending <- data.frame(chr=numeric(), startpos=numeric(),
endpos=numeric(),
cn=numeric())
extend(Object(), "Sample",
.nChrom=nChromosomes,
.chromosomeLengths=chromosomeLengths,
.chromosomes=chromosomes,
.pending=pending,
.callsComplete=FALSE
)
})

I find that the first time (and only the first time) that I call the
Constructor, say using:

> sam <- Sample(chromosomeLengths=c(25e6, 50e6, 100e6))

That I receive an error message. Any further calls to the constructor
proceed without a problem.



> library(R.oo)
Loading required package: R.methodsS3
R.methodsS3 v1.0.3 (2008-07-02) successfully loaded. See ?R.methodsS3
for help.
R.oo v1.4.6 (2008-08-11) successfully loaded. See ?R.oo for help.
> setConstructorS3("Sample", function(chromosomeLengths=NULL, ...) {
+ if (is.null(chromosomeLengths)) {
+ if (length(.GlobalEnv$chromosomeLengths) != 0) {
+ chromosomeLengths <- .GlobalEnv$chromosomeLengths
+ } else {
+ throw("Chromosome lengths must be specified!")
+ }
+ } else {
+ chromosomeLengths <- chromosomeLengths
+ }
+ nChromosomes <- length(chromosomeLengths)
+ chromosomes <- list()
+ for (ii in 1:nChromosomes) {
+ chromosomes[[ii]] <- data.frame(startpos=numeric(),
endpos=numeric(),
+ cn=numeric())
+ }
+ pending <- data.frame(chr=numeric(), startpos=numeric(),
endpos=numeric(),
+ cn=numeric())
+ extend(Object(), "Sample",
+ .nChrom=nChromosomes,
+ .chromosomeLengths=chromosomeLengths,
+ .chromosomes=chromosomes,
+ .pending=pending,
+ .callsComplete=FALSE
+ )
+ })
> sam <- Sample(chromosomeLengths=c(25e6, 50e6, 100e6))
Error in list(`Sample(chromosomeLengths = c(2.5e+07, 5e+07, 1e+08))` =
<environment>, :

[2009-07-01 10:13:46] Exception: Chromosome lengths must be specified!
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Chromosome lengths must be specified!")
at throw("Chromosome lengths must be specified!")
at constructor()
at getStaticInstance.Class(class)
at getStaticInstance(class)
at getStaticInstance.Object(this)
at getStaticInstance(this)
at extend.Object(Object(), "Sample", .nChrom =
nChromosomes, .chromosomeLength
at extend(Object(), "Sample", .nChrom =
nChromosomes, .chromosomeLengths = chr
at Sample(chromosomeLengths = c(2.5e+07, 5e+07, 1e+08))
> sam <- Sample(chromosomeLengths=c(25e6, 50e6, 100e6))
>



Any thoughts?

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] question on R.oo/R.methodsS3
parts:
Hi,

all constructor functions defined via setConstructorS3() get class
'Class' and all such Class functions must accept a call without
arguments. That is, you must design Sample() such that you can call
it as

obj <- Sample()

You can differentiate between NULL and say numeric(0).

The reason for the error occurring only the first time is that there
is a so called "static" object is created for each Class class, if
missing, and it is created the first time any other object is created.
The static object is used in cases such as Sample$loadObject(...).

Yes, this question would preferable be asked on r-devel. Similar
questions have been asked before.

Cheers,

Henrik
